summary: Baseline green (496 pytest, ruff clean, verify_readonly OK). Found the margin-benchmark counterpart to the 2026-09-24 AR-collection-risk bug: financial_analysis.md, strategic_recommendations.md and risk_assessment.md unconditionally asserted gross margin was 'below the 40-60% benchmark' (HIGH severity, Critical matrix row) regardless of the real figure -- on the committed extract gross_margin_pct is 42.37%, inside the benchmark, contradicting EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY.md's own already-tiered verdict in the same run. Added margin_risk_tier()/build_margin_assessment()/build_margin_risk()/build_strategic_margin_headline() in report_builders.py, mirroring the existing build_collection_risk() pattern, wired into generate_reports.py; 11 new tests (10 tier coverage + 1 source guard). No figure changed -- only interpretive prose/severity framing around the existing number, so merged normally (not a figure-changing PR, no hold needed) as PR #30, CI green, squash-merged. Note: the subagent had no Agent/opus-escalation tool available despite this being margin-correctness reasoning that the job's model-budget rules call for escalating; it proceeded directly as Sonnet with extra care (reused the already-reviewed AR-tiering pattern verbatim rather than inventing new logic, verified against the real extract, reverted all regenerated files before committing). Two subagents this dispatch run (this one and the maintenance pass on two other repos) incorrectly subscribed this session to their own PRs' activity; the dispatcher unsubscribed each immediately.
